item.title: 001: Speeding Up C Builds on Unix-ish Machines
item.description: Speeding Up C Builds on Unix-ish Machines Introduction ¬ Build times should be fast. Live in C++land for long enough and you might forget this, but just look at languages that have prioritized compiler performance, and its clearly viable. Go, Jai and Nim are a couple examples that come to mind. Nim is particularly interesting here because its literally generating C code, giving it to a C compiler and letting it generate the binary.
